endDate.title: endDate
endDate.description: The end date for the term-defined product provided in the request, which is formatted as yyyy-mm-dd.

productId.title: productId
productId.description: The Product2Id for the product to be added to the quote.

productSellingModelID.title: productSellingModelID
productSellingModelID.description: The default product selling model ID associated with the product provided in the request.

quantity.title: quantity
quantity.description: The quantity of the product to be added to the quote line. If no quantity is provided, default to 1.

quoteId.title: quoteId
quoteId.description: The quote Id of the quote record to be modified.

startDate.title: startDate
startDate.description: The startDate, needed only for subscription based products. The format must be yyyy-mm-dd. always add it
